Elite Barbarian Helms
(Normal Barbarian Helms | Exceptional Barbarian Helms)

Barbarian Helms can have 1-3 bonuses of +1-3 to specific Barbarian skills and can only be worn by Barbarians and Barbarian Hirelings.
